notes.title: Oasis Release 0917
notes.notes:
Hi guys, we're going to update our game and the server of Oasis will be shut down for about 4 hours today.

[Update time] 
23:00 PM to 9:00AM PST
[Update method]
Stop service update
  Online players who have logged in before 23:00PM will receive a drop notification
[Update range] 
Android PC full server
[Optimized content]
1. Optimized VR ray appearance and selection rules
2. Fixed the problem of low refresh of the VR voice logo and not fully following the headset
3. Fixed the problem of VR floating UI jitter
4. Increased the time for VR players to enter AFK mode after taking off the headset
5. Fixed the problem of abnormal posture of some models in VR
6. Beautify VR rays and stroke effects
7. In VR mode, a quick switch button for standing and sitting in the main menu has been added
8. Optimized the flight speed when throwing objects
9. Optimized 3D sound effects
10. Increased the scroll speed of the world list wheel
11. Optimized the position of the menu when switching models
12. Removed the recommended sign on the main menu interface

notes.title: Oasis Release Note 2020.0901
notes.notes:
Dear players, we plan to update our outage service on September 1st, with an estimated maintenance time of two hours.

Update mode
Stop service update

Update range
full service

New Content
[olist]
 Backpack system -- unlock different items according to the level
 The world process -- building the oasis opens a new system
 How to play credits -- Adding wishing Pool and points exchange shop to “Credits Casino"
 Daily tasks -- Get more points
[/olist]

VR Optimization
[olist]
 Solved the hip distortion bug of part of the role model
 Optimized the third-person moving experience
 Solved the occasional ray ball bug in the game
 Adjusted the position of the model when entering the map in full-body tracking mode
[/olist]

notes.title: Release Note
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36055493/de9244ee2930f14017aa74c492fbffb7fbe9945e.jpg

Oasis-Oasis VR2020.07.28
Dear gamers, we plan to stop the server update on July 28. The estimated maintenance time is 2 hours.

Update method
Stop service update

Update range
Full server

New Content
1. The world page will show friends in the world
2. Added "Recent" tab to display recently visited rooms
3. Added the shortcut menu of the most commonly used models
4. Added phrase reply function
5. The upper limit of the level has been raised to level 30, and the experience mechanism has been modified
6. Brand new special effects nameplate (the old nameplate has been cancelled)
7. The points system is added, and "World: Casino" is updated to "World: Point Casino"
-Points compensation for old players: 
(1) Points compensation for existing level experience (compensation is 1.5 times the points obtained by the same experience after the update)
(2) Players who have uploaded World/Home/Avatar will reissue their points according to the new rules
(3) The old player nameplate will be reissued in the next version

VR optimization
1. Uncheck the ray when selecting the seat
2. Reduced the stroke area of ​​the seat in the official map
3. Optimized mouth shape performance
4. Fixed the bug of gesture realization
5. The game supports hot plugging of handles and body tracking devices
6. The position of the model during the whole-body tracking calibration is closer to the player's real position
7. A switch for body tracking has been added to the main menu

If you have any questions, please contact us in Discord

notes.title: 0.99 Release Note
notes.notes:
Hi guys, our server is going to be shutdown to update the game. It will take about 2 hours.

0.99 release note

-BUG fixes: 
[olist]
 Fixed the crash problem when model, matching and switching resources
 Fixed the issue of theater sound shielding
 Fixed the problem that the friend application interface is overwritten
[/olist]

-VR Performance Optimization: 
[olist]
 Optimized VR character arm and shoulder torsion performance
 Adjusted VR moving speed (control 0-1 coefficient according to input shaft force)
 Added VR continuous steering function
 Optimized VR pickup experience
[/olist]

-VR Device Adaptation: 
[olist]
 Add SteamVR compatible devices
[/olist]
